notes: 8F-A maps active cohort and participation policy with fixed client-level DP. Balanced participation distributes active clients across all ten local speed categories; random participation is seeded; biased participation selects low-speed categories first. 8F-B freezes three epsilon=4 points from prior 8E (10 nonviable, 30 boundary, 100 viable) and tests public-box narrowing, +5% shift, injected out-of-box contribution contamination, and an unseen lower-friction nonlinear test plant. Outlier contamination scales the first two fitted ratios by 1.35 and 0.70 and the third by 1.30 for a fixed seeded fraction; it is an aggregation-contamination test, not newly simulated vehicle identification. Utility is <=10% tracking degradation from each matching non-private release, full amplitude feasibility, and frozen rho<1. The 15% 8E exploratory gate is not reused.
